description: This file contains implementation of functions related to WLD endpoints, including creation, deletion, profile management, and configuration of endpoint parameters in a wireless LAN driver. It also interacts with external libraries and defines internal utility functions.

classes.name: T_EndPoint
classes.description: Represents an endpoint in the wireless system, includes FSM and associated configurations.

classes.name: T_EndPointStats
classes.description: Structure to hold statistics related to an endpoint, such as transmitted bytes and packets.

methods.name: T_EndPoint * wld_th_ep_createEp(amxb_bus_ctx_t * const bus_ctx,wld_th_mockVendor_t * mockVendor _UNUSED,T_Radio * radio,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a new endpoint interface, registers it through bus context, and returns the endpoint object.

methods.name: void wld_th_ep_deleteEp(amxb_bus_ctx_t * const bus_ctx,wld_th_mockVendor_t * mockVendor _UNUSED,const char * name)
methods.description: Deletes an endpoint interface identified by name using bus context commands.

methods.name: amxd_object_t * wld_th_ep_createProfile(T_EndPoint * ep,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a new profile for the specified endpoint with the given name.

methods.name: void wld_th_ep_doFsmClean(T_EndPoint * pEP)
methods.description: Resets the FSM bits of the endpoint to clean state.

methods.name: void wld_th_ep_setEnable(T_EndPoint * pEP,bool enable,bool commit)
methods.description: Enables or disables the endpoint, optionally committing the change.

methods.name: void wld_th_ep_setSSIDEnable(T_EndPoint * pEP,bool enable,bool commit)
methods.description: Enables or disables the SSID for the endpoint, optionally committing the change.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_th_ep_getStats(T_EndPoint * pEP _UNUSED,T_EndPointStats * stats)
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for the endpoint, such as transmitted bytes and packets, and security mode.
